 Flames at Kings projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 14, 2026 
 Link copied 
 FLAMES (8-10-1) at KINGS (5-10-2) 
 10 p.m. ET; ABTV, SN, TVAS 
 Flames projected lineup 
 Joel Farabee -- Mikael Backlund -- Matt Coronato
 Yegor Sharangovich -- Morgan Frost -- Adam Klapka
 Matvei Gridin -- Martin Pospisil -- Ryan Strome
 William Stromgren -- Jonathan Castagna -- Aydar Suniev
 Joel Hanley -- Simon Nemec
 Jake Middleton -- Zach Whitecloud
 Yan Kuznetsov -- Zayne Parekh
 Dustin Wolf
 Devin Cooley
 Scratched: Maksim Tsyplakov, Brennan Othmann, Brayden Pachal 
 Injured: Jonathan Huberdeau (hip), Kevin Bahl (lower body) 
 Kings projected lineup 
 Alex Turcotte -- Alex Laferriere -- Adrian Kempe
 Kevin Fiala -- Quinton Byfield -- Mats Zuccarello
 Trevor Moore -- Erik Haula -- Joel Armia
 Andre Lee -- Scott Laughton -- Corey Perry
 Brian Dumoulin -- Brandt Clarke
 Mikey Anderson -- Drew Doughty
 Joel Edmundson -- Cody Ceci
 Anton Forsberg
 Darcy Kuemper
 Scratched: Artemi Panarin, Samuel Helenius 
 Injured: Erik Gustafsson (undisclosed) 
 Status report 
 Huberdeau, a forward who has yet to play this season, did not travel with the Flames for their three-game California road trip. … Panarin, a forward, will not play for personal reasons; Turcotte will take his place on the first line. … Gustafsson has resumed practicing but the defenseman is expected to miss his third straight game.
